exposure: induction of labor (IOL) with a Foley catheter
Induction of labour with a Foley catheter
cohort: 640 women undergoing induction of labor at 41 weeks gestation
finding: While spontaneous vaginal birth rates following IOL with a Foley catheter were similar between midwife- and consultant-led care, the midwife-led group had a higher risk of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that while spontaneous vaginal birth rates were similar between midwife-led and consultant-led care for induction of labour with a Foley catheter, the midwife-led group had a higher risk of adverse neonatal outcomes.
